Boston Consulting Group (BCG) and the World Economic Forum (WEF) are just two of the many
groups to recently endorse stakeholder capitalism. One of the five tenets of BCG’s Winning the 20s
leadership agenda is “optimizing for both social and business value”. WEF, in turn, updated their
Davos Manifesto for 2020 for the first time since 1973, writing that “the purpose of a company is to
engage all its stakeholders in shared and sustained value creation”.
“There has been an increasing shift away
from shareholder value management to
stakeholder management approaches.”
- Investor
Obviously a shift like this in both business zeitgeist and legislation is something that reaches far
beyond the startup ecosystem. However, young companies are demonstrably very adept at business
model innovation when it comes to more limited problems. What’s to say that that energy can’t be
redirected to reinvent capitalism itself?
